column1: # Hebrew (he) pronunciation lexicon — skeleton (unvocalized) <TAB> niqqud (vocalized). A LOOKUP layer for the
# Phase-A wordlist: a Hebrew Wikipedia frequency ranking (hewiki dump, CC-BY-SA — ranking only; the niqqud
# content is Phonikud output validated by ReNikud, both CC-BY — see tools/hebrew/build-lexicon.py).
# neural path: a known skeleton renders via phonemizeWord(niqqud) — i.e. through OUR g2p, so it auto-tracks our
# canonical convention (the glottal rule etc.). OOV words + HOMOGRAPHS fall through to the context tagger.
# Built (tools/hebrew/build-lexicon.py): Phonikud's diacritization of the frequency list, VALIDATED where our
# g2p rendering of it agrees with ReNikud (audio-supervised), with homograph skeletons EXCLUDED (left to the
# tagger's context). Net-positive on BOTH referees — human Nakdimon holdout 86.5→87.8, independent gt.tsv
# 64.8→66.7. Eval-validated; the niqqud is a reading only (rendered through our convention, never PK's IPA).
